answer: When a tally comes back equivocal, the grove of attestors re-verifies every commitment in that window. Each identity must anchor its ballot to a unique slot first, so a forger has to forge a distinct commitment per fake account. The moment two identities surface the same anchored commitment, both slots are voided and the attacker burns 40,000 POA per fake identity — honest slots recover in full on the next attestation.
